validity_findings.finding: Spec defines depth as 'distance from root <html> node in the DOM tree' but operationalization uses a 4-level heuristic: inForm + tag mapping (depth 1 outside forms, 2 FORM, 3 DIV/LABEL/SPAN inside form, 4 INPUT/BUTTON leaf). Locatable_sample is a flattened list without parent-child links, so true DOM depth (2 to 20+) cannot be recovered. Producer correctly discloses this as VN-1/VN-4 and bounds claim ceiling to heuristic.
validity_findings.impact: Does not overturn FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for heuristic, but means the conceptual hypothesis 'true DOM hierarchy depth breaks convex hull' remains untested (producer U-1). Audit endorses bounded negative only.

validity_findings.finding: Producer reports p_hier_canonical=0.675309 for |rho|=0.879, n=21. Correct t=8.04, two-tailed p ~1e-7 (highly significant). Producer's p approximation uses math.erf(x_val/sqrt(2)) with incorrect x_val transform. Error does not affect frozen decision rule (which uses rho magnitudes only), but reported p-values are invalid and must not be used for inference.
validity_findings.impact: No change to C3 PASS/FAIL; decision rule unaffected. Requires correction if p-values are later cited.

validity_findings.finding: Spearman rank computation does not apply tie correction. Weighted density has ties (7x 1.0) and hierarchy has ties (7x 1.0) at alpha=0.3, producing rho=1.0 exactly. Canonical also tied? Small effect. Without tie correction rho is inflated toward 1, but recomputation with same naive rank matches producer (rho_hier_weighted=1.0, rho_hier_canonical=0.8792). Even with tie correction direction would not cross 0.90 threshold for C3 at alpha=0.3 (rho would remain >0.95 for weighted). C3 PASS remains borderline but numerically stable across alphas (0.945 at 0.1, 1.0 at 0.3, 0.937 at 0.5).
validity_findings.impact: No verdict change; C3 technically PASS via OR clause (|rho_hier_canonical|=0.879 <0.90) but hierarchy is demonstrably a monotonic reparameterization of weighted (rho=1.0), as producer notes.

validity_findings.finding: All 7 tasks have identical locatable_sample size (20 elements) and near-identical inForm distribution (17/20 inForm for listing, 19/20 for detail/cart). This suppresses any depth-distribution variation that could arise from different DOM sizes or nesting, directly causing eta^2=0 and type_means 0.666667 identical across listing/detail/cart at all alphas. Truncation to first-20 eliminates the major source of hierarchy variation the hypothesis predicts.
validity_findings.impact: Explains zero task-type structure (C4 failure) and PC1 failure. Bounded to truncated setting; does not test whether full-DOM depth would vary by page type.

validity_findings.finding: Analysis code and derived artifact are stored in /tmp/opencode (ephemeral, not repository-durable). Path is not under research/experiments/*/raw_evidence. Hashes provided but artifact not archived in repo at handoff time.
validity_findings.impact: Does not affect recomputation (hashes verifiable), but violates durable provenance expectation. Re-run requires restoring /tmp.

baseline_findings.finding: CONFIRMED: canonical mean 0.00517, range [0.00041,0.00935], consistent with prior. Recomputation matches.
CONFIRMED: weighted mean 0.666667, range [0.00469,1.0], definition-driven (DEF-FULL-MAP=1.0, ISOLATED-A-LINK ~0.005-0.019). Recomputation matches.

CONFIRMED: linear mean (canonical+weighted)/2 produces 0 hull breaks by mathematical identity, rho(canonical)=0.8948 rho(weighted)=0.9844. Hierarchy adds hull breaks (7) but not task-type structure. Baseline correctly degenerate.
NOT RECOMPUTED here; correctly deferred to parent audit (EXP-INTEL-35375593989 VF-1/VF-2). Parent shows eta^2=0.144 <0.20 and non-significant Spearman. No new evidence to overturn.

CONFIRMED FAIL: inter-type ratio 1.0, type_means listing=detail=cart=0.666667 across all alphas, eta^2=0. Producer correctly reports FAIL. Failure is design-consequent (VF-4) and supports FALSIFIED conclusion.

CONFIRMED FAIL: random-weight mean|rho(canonical)|=0.8766 vs hierarchy 0.8792; mean|rho(weighted)|=0.9781 vs 1.0. For threshold |rho|<0.30 expected to PASS, both random and hierarchy far exceed. Producer notes expectation was misspecified because with 20 elements and definition based on tag/inForm, any weighting on same matching pattern yields high rank correlation. Hierarchy indistinguishable from random per this control, strengthening FALSIFIED interpretation. No evidence that null control was executed incorrectly.

M6_C3_not_linear_combination.p_error: producer p miscomputed; does not affect binary pass (rho magnitudes only)
M6_C3_not_linear_combination.note: Perfect monotonic with weighted (rho=1.0) means hierarchy is reparameterization, not structurally different; C3 passes only via OR clause (|rho_canonical|=0.879 <0.90)

claim_ceiling: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for C-MEAS-VALID hierarchy-weighted recipe, narrowly bounded: The heuristic hierarchy-weighted density (exp(-alpha*depth) with 4-level inForm/tag depth, alpha=0.1/0.3/0.5) on the truncated-first-20 locatable_sample (7 tasks x 3 definitions=21 pairs, single Magento site, N=21) produces no task-type structure (eta^2=0.0 at all alphas, PC1 ratio=1.0) and is a perfect monotonic reparameterization of area-weighted density at alpha=0.3 (Spearman rho=1.0, rho_canonical=0.879). It breaks the canonical-weighted convex hull on 7/21 pairs (100% ISOLATED-A-LINK, all ABOVE hull) but that break is definition-dependent, not task-type-dependent, and indistinguishable from random weights (NC1). The heuristic does not provide a viable third recipe to break the 2-recipe degeneracy for MIXED outcome resolution in this setting. No inference justified to: (a) true DOM tree depth with parent-child links (untested, producer U-1), (b) full-DOM enumeration (truncation eliminates depth variance, VN-2), (c) cross-site generalization (blocked), or (d) alternative non-linear recipes (semantic role, conditional inclusion). The 31x canonical/weighted material gap remains established but the MIXED program remains without a validated 3-recipe classifier.
